text.name: rm_fm_settings_availability_tooltip
text.text: Controls how many fields are available for purchase. Higher difficulty means fewer fields and longer waits. Fields rotate based on a seasonal market (more listings Nov-Mar). 'Realistic' is extreme - most fields stay locked for months.

text.name: rm_fm_settings_priceMultiplier_tooltip
text.text: Multiplier applied to the base farmland price per hectare.

text.name: rm_fm_settings_negotiation_tooltip
text.text: When enabled, buying and selling farmland requires negotiation instead of instant transactions. Prices are negotiated through multi-round offers and counter-offers.
